verdict.rationale: Omarchy exposes an official `omarchy` CLI documented at a dedicated manual page, explicitly noted as useful for AI agents to control customization/configuration, but this is a local shell CLI, not a documented public API (no REST/OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt) — probes confirm no openapi.json/swagger.json and no llms.txt exist. missing for 10: a documented public API/HTTP interface (openapi.json, REST endpoint, or llms.txt), remote/programmatic access beyond local CLI invocation, and any SDK or API reference beyond the CLI manual.
